task: Roadmap 4.5c: Bomber / Heavy Assault gameplay (owner decision 20)

baseline.note: Reproduced with npm run build:candidate -- --quiet before and after the experiment. Full suite at a clean export: 640 tests, 115 failing (unchanged).

evidence_branch.note: Complete 4.5c implementation kept for a retry once capacity exists. ld65 rejects the link. Not a candidate and not a baseline. Behaviour was never executed, so gameplay correctness is unverified.

c: EnemyArchetype record 4 (offset 36): HP 4, movement BOMBER_LANE_SWEEP = 3, fire SINGLE_SHOT, burst 1, interval 0, pause 80/64/48, renderer TWO_HEAVY_PMG, weapon_class BOMBER = 3, score $50

TEMPORARY 4.5 HEAVY SMOKE SCHEDULER {Raider, Bomber}: per-formation record offset, roster shape (0 / 2 SCYTHE_BOMBER), hull colour ($44 / $24) and a provisional Light-escort column (1 / 0). The escort rule lives only in schedule data.
heavy_publish_profile: the enemy_profile_* cache is copied from the selected record offset (was hardcoded record 0)

enemy_c_spawn_raiders: selects the formation, publishes the profile, sets HP from the record and, for a lane sweep, writes the formation start data (X 48/176, Y 0/0, direction +1/-1, first shot 48/72, first turn 60/52)

enemy_c_heavy_tick (per member): entry at 1 line/frame to depth 40 (slot 0) or 16 (slot 1), then 1 line every other frame, de-phased by slot; 1 HPOS/frame sweep; turns at lane bounds [48,92] / [132,176] or on a per-slot timer reloaded to 24 + (frame & 31); independent fire timer; fires only for Y 24..200, player not dying, capital not due; returns 0 or the record weapon_class
asm: update_enemy: operand-only redirection jsr update_enemy_slot_motion -> jsr heavy_member_update (per member, after the old Y is captured, before draw and erase_enemy_departing_row)

heavy_member_update (HEAVY_CODE, LIGHTFILE after LIGHT_CODE): Raider movement id keeps the ASM motion; otherwise marshals the member's five slot bytes $5478-$5481 into C scalars, calls enemy_c_heavy_tick, stores them back and emits the returned class

allocate_interceptor_projectile: generic class in A, ACTIVE = (class << 3) | 2 | slot via asl/sec/rol/asl; the Raider runtime passes ENEMY_PROFILE_WEAPON_CLASS and loses its PULSE-only check (no eor to BOMBER)
integration_update_enemy: the Raider-only movement gate is retired (7 B NOP pad keeps CODE addresses)
c-asm-abi.s (HYBRID_C_HEAVY): spawn and recycle veneers write heavy_hull_colour to COLPM1/COLPM2; C recycle restores $44 because P1/P2 colour the capital broadside missiles M1/M2 under PRIOR 0
enemy-roster.json: SCYTHE_BOMBER hardwareWidth DOUBLE -> QUAD (32 HPOS visible and collision width, table data only)

measurements.method: ld65 link of the experiment (HYBRID_C_HEAVY_RAM widened in a scratch copy only) reading __HYBRID_C_HEAVY_SIZE__, __HYBRID_C_EXT_SIZE__ and __ENEMY_ARCHETYPE_DATA_SIZE__; per-function sizes from the ca65 listing of the cc65 output; main-link segment sizes from build/main.lst. The production link fails with 'Segment HYBRID_C_HEAVY overflows memory area HYBRID_C_HEAVY_RAM by 148 bytes'.

hybrid_c_ext.note: The formation admission and profile publication moved to HYBRID_C_HEAVY (EXT C+data 675 -> 613 B); the Light escort admission stays in EXT as encounter_light_admit (69 B).

bss.HYBRID_HEAVY_STATE: $811B-$8123 (9 B: archetype offset, hull colour, five member scalars, two scratch bytes), previously unowned

deficit.note: Same order in any arrangement: keeping admission/profile in EXT fits HEAVY (173 B) but overflows EXT by about 192 B.

rejected_compactions: Per-slot C arrays indexed by ENEMY_TARGET_SLOT: cc65 builds a ptr1 pointer for any indexed update (helper audit fails); the scratch-store form avoids ptr1 but the tick grows to about 237-277 B
cc65 --codesize 50: lifecycle C grows (HEAVY 376 -> 641 B listing count)

not_measured: PAL cycles, boot smoke, debris gate and native replays: the image does not link
Transport sectors and ATR menu deadline for a 391-B heavy image (ESTIMATE: +2 low-C record sectors; the 4.5a 239-B proof met the deadline with 0 frames of margin)

alternatives.name: Capacity step: widen the Heavy window
alternatives.change: Move the A2 cold staging ($7F2B) and the gameplay-init A2 display lists ($7F10) so HYBRID_C_HEAVY grows by at least 148 B; the 8-bit hold/publish copies would need a 16-bit or two-part copy.
alternatives.ram_code_cost: reserved envelope +148 B or more, physical +148 B at runtime; boot copy code grows in the bootstrap prefix, which has only 2 B of padding left after 4.5b
alternatives.cpu_cost: ESTIMATE one-time hold + publish copies about +4,800 cycles (4.5a measured about 16 cycles/B per copy); no gameplay cost
alternatives.risk: memory-architecture change on the boot path with 0 frames of ATR menu margin; needs a 4.5a-style write-watch and boot smoke

alternatives.name: Behaviour-neutral compaction checkpoint of existing EXT C
alternatives.change: Rewrite enemy_c_apply_pending_damage (105 B, duplicated per slot) and other EXT C with the scratch/scalar patterns found here, proven behaviourally equivalent in the 6502 harness, before retrying 4.5c.
alternatives.ram_code_cost: ESTIMATE 40-90 B recovered; not shown to reach 136 B
alternatives.risk: touches accepted Heavy HP / Light code; may still fall short and need A as well

alternatives.name: Owner-approved scope reduction for 4.5c
alternatives.change: For example drop timer-driven turns (about 25 B) or the generic profile loop. Measured savings do not close the 136 B gap alone.
alternatives.player_visible_effect: less varied Bomber sweep or a non-generic Heavy profile

recommendation: A: a bounded capacity step for the Heavy window (the 4.5a pattern), then retry 4.5c from 8e138a8 unchanged.
